text.text_excerpt: It's good Chinese at a really good price and they will deliver to my work @ Ochsner Medical. The lunch specials are all $7 or less and a ton of food. One lunch special is two filling meals for me. Definitely four stars for the price, taste and convenience... solid lunch place if you're in the area or have family staying on the hospital.

I stopped here for a quick take-out dinner on a cold, rainy night. I was pleasantly surprised and wished it was closer to my house! I ordered General Tso's chicken and Orange Chicken and both were delicious and super fresh!! The rice was tasty and moist. I gave my eggroll to my friend so I can't vouch for that, but all in all is was a great experience. I went in to order and my food was ready about 15 minutes later. The inside is a little rough, but I'm not going to judge because it's obviously a small family operation and I wasn't eating in so it's not my problem. If you're looking for "real" gourmet Chinese food, keep moving. But if you want a great, fresh, affordable, neighborhood-type...

Been doing take out here for a few years. It's pretty consistent..food is good, not great great, but good enough for a quick hot meal. Prices are very affordable and the platters are stuffed. We usually have left overs easily. Costumer service is friendly, but not particularly warm. Delivery would make this place near perfect.
